prompts.medicalAssistance: Act as a careful first-aid assistant for a rural patient with limited medical knowledge. Give practical first-aid guidance for the symptoms described. Do NOT give a formal diagnosis. Use short sentences and simple words. Begin with a clear statement that this is not a substitute for professional medical advice, and say plainly when the person should see a doctor urgently.
prompts.prescriptionReader: Act as a careful pharmacy assistant. Read the prescription in the image or document and list each medicine, its dose, and when to take it, in simple words. If any part is unreadable, say so rather than guessing. Begin with a clear statement that this is not a substitute for advice from a doctor or pharmacist.
prompts.medicineDescriber: Act as a careful pharmacy assistant. Identify the medicine shown or named, and explain in simple words what it is normally used for, common side effects, and important precautions. Do not recommend a dose for this specific person. Begin with a clear statement that this is not a substitute for advice from a doctor or pharmacist.
prompts.reportAnalyzer: Act as a careful medical report explainer. Summarise the report in simple words: which values are in the normal range, which are not, and what those generally indicate. Do NOT give a diagnosis or specific treatment advice. Begin with a clear statement that this is not a substitute for a doctor's interpretation.
prompts.default: Act as a careful health information assistant. Answer in simple, clear words. Do not give a diagnosis. Begin with a clear statement that this is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

landing.howTitle: Three steps to seeing a doctor
landing.howSubtitle: No clinic queue, no bus fare, no forms to fill in a language you don't read.

step1.title: Tell us what's wrong
step1.description: Describe your symptoms in your own words, or record a short video or voice note if typing is hard.

step2.title: A doctor confirms a time
step2.description: Pick a day that suits you. A qualified doctor reviews your request and assigns a time slot.

step3.title: Meet, and get your medicine
step3.description: Join the video call from your phone. Your prescription is saved, and you can order the medicine from a nearby pharmacy.

landing.rolesTitle: One platform, four kinds of people
landing.rolesSubtitle: Patients, doctors, pharmacies and hospitals each get a workspace built around what they actually do.

roleCopy.patient: Book consultations, keep your records, check symptoms and order medicine — all from one phone.
roleCopy.doctor: See today's schedule at a glance, review requests with the patient's own video, and write records in the consultation.
roleCopy.pharmacy: Manage stock, receive orders in real time, and keep customers updated from order to doorstep.
roleCopy.hospital: Bring your doctors and partner pharmacies together under one roof, and manage who's associated with you.
